notes.title: Lunar Mirror will be officially launched on Steam EA on January 19
notes.content:
Hi, gentlemen
we decided to officially launch "Lunar Mirror" on steam EA on January 19. The EA version of "Lunar Mirror" will contain all the contents of the first chapter. you can experience it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910790/Lunar_Mirror/
"Lunar Mirror" is a horror puzzle game with amazing elements. A sudden astronomical anomaly led to the disappearance of students one after another, and a mysterious society that is happy with love is quietly rising again. What is the connection between your missing girlfriend and them? With the deepening of the investigation, the history of the campus slowly surfaced, but the truth became more complicated

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42201006/6bbd18e40fc565f1a631f76cddf2f340ed307f27.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Why are the girls missing in school
[*] Why are boys keen on midnight activities organized by clubs
[*] What happened ten years ago? Why did the school move to the barren mountains
[*] What kind of conspiracy is the mysterious rising society planning on campus
[*] Religion with childbearing as its theme, combined with horror elements and stunning stimulation, brings new sensory experiences.
[/list]
[h2][b]Note: Friendly tips. First of all, this game is a horror game, followed by the feature content. The game contains thriller elements, so buy carefully!!![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42201006/cab015c56cf43adcffd9902aa8c20f164e2a3f3b.gif[/img]
At the same time, I am sorry that the development progress has been delayed again and again due to the current downward environment and the influence of COVID-19 on team members. Finally, we have to let the game meet with all players in EA mode. I hope that everything will be smooth in the new year and the full picture of the game will be shown to all players as soon as possible.
Finally, I wish you a happy new year in advance
——Mirror of the Moon development team

notes.title: Lunar Mirror 2023.1.13 finalized
notes.content:
Hi, gentlemen
Due to various reasons, the release date of "Lunar mirror", which has been delayed for a long time, has [h2]finally been confirmed! The game will be officially launched on the afternoon of January 13, 2023![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910790/_/
"Lunar Mirror " is a horror, suspense and decryption game with the theme of Cthulhu on campus. Nishimura Qiren's girlfriend mysteriously disappeared on campus. With the help of his friends, Qiren discovered that the disappearance of his girlfriend was linked to the school's weird clubs that are keen on organizing "late night fellowship". As the investigation deepened, strange events happened one after another. , The huge conspiracy behind it also slowly surfaced...
If you can't wait to experience it first, the demo is now on the game store, and you can download and play for free.

[h2]At the same time, let's preview that "Lunar Mirror: The Pavilion of Desire" will also be launched soon![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2157680/_/?curator_clanid=34942634
This game is a derivative work of "Lunar Mirror", telling the story of how mysterious religions develop believers through societies. The gameplay is the same as that of Lunar Mirror which complements some of the story settings of Mirror of the Moon. If you like this type of game, please add it to the wishlist first.
